candidate_predicates.name: IS_PLAN
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning explicitly expresses one or more intended future actions or an ordered sequence of actions that the agent intends to perform.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text expressing an intended action or sequence of planned steps.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning contains at least one explicit statement of a future action or planned step.
The intended action is not merely reported as already completed.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only reports prior results, observations, or the current state.
The reasoning only restates the task without indicating any action the agent intends to take.

candidate_predicates.name: FRAMES_OBJECTIVE_WITH_CONSTRAINTS
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning explicitly sets out the target objective together with one or more constraints that limit acceptable actions or require preservation of specified content.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text framing the objective and its associated constraints.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning states a goal to be achieved.
The reasoning states at least one constraint, prohibition, or preservation requirement relevant to achieving that goal.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only lists planned actions without identifying any constraint or preservation requirement.
The reasoning only reports completed outcomes without framing an objective and its constraints.

candidate_predicates.name: EXECUTES_PLANNED_STEP
candidate_predicates.definition: The action performs a concrete step that the reasoning explicitly identified as an intended future action in service of the current objective.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The action that executes a planned step.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that specifies the intended action or step being executed.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning specifies an intended action or step.
The action's operation matches that intended step closely enough to be identifiable as its execution.
The action is performed as an implementation of the plan rather than merely being topically adjacent to it.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning does not specify the action taken.
The action diverges from the planned step or is performed for an unrelated purpose.

candidate_predicates.name: GROUNDS_CONCLUSION_IN_OBSERVATION
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning draws a conclusion or inference using identifiable content from the observation as supporting evidence.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning expressing the evidence-based conclusion or inference.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observation supplying evidence for that conclusion.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning states a conclusion, diagnosis, or inference.
The observation contains specific information that supports or motivates that conclusion.
The connection is inferential rather than mere repetition of the observation.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning merely repeats the observation without drawing a conclusion.
The observation is unrelated to the conclusion or provides no identifiable support.

candidate_predicates.name: EXPLAINS_ANOMALOUS_OBSERVATION_WITH_CAUSAL_MECHANISM
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning explains an observation that is unexpected, absent, or apparently inconsistent by identifying a causal mechanism that accounts for it.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that explains the apparent anomaly using a causal mechanism.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the unexpected, absent, or apparently inconsistent result.

assertion_conditions: The observation reports a result that is unexpected or apparently inconsistent with prior evidence or expectations.
The reasoning identifies a causal mechanism that resolves the apparent anomaly.
exclusion_conditions: The observation is consistent with expectations and no anomaly is addressed.
The reasoning merely restates the observation or draws an ordinary conclusion without explaining an anomaly.
